title: Extension Migration
seo: Manifest V2 to V3 extension migration
meta: Move an older Manifest V2 extension to Manifest V3 or port it to another browser, with saved data kept. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Extension migration to Manifest V3 or a new browser
overview: Older Manifest V2 extensions stop working as browsers retire them. We move yours to Manifest V3 by replacing background pages with service workers, updating how web requests and scripts run, and keeping your users' saved settings intact. We test each feature after the move and tell you plainly if something has to work differently. You receive the migrated code and a before and after feature checklist.

faq: Will my users lose their saved settings?
We aim to keep them. We map the old storage to the new format, add a one-time import on first run and test it with sample data before release. We tell you if any field cannot carry over.
Can every V2 feature work in V3?
Most can, but some, such as blocking requests on the fly, work differently. We list those cases up front, offer the closest V3 approach and explain what changes for your users.
Is my store listing affected by the move?
The listing stays the same. You upload the new version as an update to the same item, so reviews and installs remain attached to it. We prepare the package and notes for that.
Can you also bring it to Firefox or Safari?
Yes. Premium includes one extra browser package. Safari needs an Apple developer account and a Mac build step, so we confirm those details with you first.
